title: Megan Thee Stallion Finds ‘Good Luck’ Charm in Orange Cat She Named Miso While Recording ‘Act III’
summary: The rapper had a special regular visitor at the studio this summer.
contentText:
Megan Thee Stallion has been hard at work on her upcoming Act III album, and she’s had a special feline visitor. Megan posted a video to social media on Sunday (Aug. 16), featuring an orange cat that’s been along for the journey at the studio.

“This orange cat keeps coming to see me everytime I’m recording for my album 🥹 I’m talking waiting on me to pull up to the studio lol I named her MISO 🧡 my girl a street cat and I can’t tell if she wants to come home with me but she’s been down for thee whole ACTIII process,” she captioned her TikTok. “What are thee odds she’s orangeee😻 I think it means good luck idk hotties lol.”

The heartwarming clip finds Miso sporting an adorable smile while hanging out on the roof of a car and then joining the crew in the studio, where she wants all the pets and snuggles. Megan’s team even fed the orange cat with some pieces of expensive steak from STK.

The Hotties implored Meg to take her home, as orange female cats are not as common. “She doesn’t even know your status, she loves you for you. Keep her,” one person wrote.

Megan has plenty of pets at home, including a Maine Coon cat named 9 as well as three French bulldogs (Dos, Foe and Onita), a pit bull (5ive), a Cane Corso (X), a rescue pup (Tyger) and a Merle pooch (Six).

The 31-year-old rapper continued to tease her anticipated album on Instagram with a lingerie photo shoot alongside a wolf, which is soundtracked by Deftones’ “Change (in the House of Flies).” Megan has teased how the new music will welcome the return of her Tina Snow alter ego.

The three-time Grammy winner’s next era will be launched by a new label partnership, as the Houston Hottie announced a distribution partnership deal with Interscope Records Aug. 14. The agreement will allow her to keep full ownership of her masters and publishing, while releasing music through her Hot Girl Productions company.

“I’ve always wanted to create music on my terms while building a legacy that extends beyond the industry,” Megan said in a statement at the time. “This distribution partnership with Interscope allows me to stay true to my creative vision while also increasing my global reach. I’m excited for this next chapter of growth and the expansion of my Hot Girl Productions empire.”

Megan Thee Stallion’s last album came with Megan in 2024, which  debuted at No. 3  on the  Billboard 200 . She boasts three No. 1 hits and 43 entries on the  Billboard Hot 100 , while all three of her studio albums have reached the  Billboard 200 ’s top five.
